senses.gloss:
पौष पौष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्य), relating
to or occurring at the time when the moon is in the
asterism Puṣya; (अस्), m., N. of a month, the
month Pauṣa (December-January, when the full
moon is in the asterism Puṣya); N. of the third
year in the twelve years' cycle of Jupiter; (ई), f. the
night or day of full moon in the month Pauṣa;
(अम्), n. a festival or a particular festival; a fight,
combat; N. of various Sāmans; [cf. पौष्य.]

पौष्कर पौष्कर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्कर),
relating to the blue lotus-flower, made or consisting
[]
of blue lotuses, treating of the blue lotus; (with
प्रादुर्-भाव) the appearance of Viṣṇu in the
form of a lotus-flower; belonging to or derived from
Costus Speciosus or C. Arabicus; (अम्), n. the root or
fruit of the plant Costus Speciosus or C. Arabicus.

पौष्करक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the blue
lotus-flower, consisting of blue lotuses; (with प्रा-
दुर्-भाव) the appearance of Viṣṇu in the form
of a lotus-flower.

पौष्करसादि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. पुष्-
कर-सद्), N. of a grammarian.

पौष्करिणी, f. = पुष्करिणी, a lotus-pool, a
large pond or reservoir.

पौष्करेयक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ.
IV. 2, 95.

पौष्कल पौष्कल, अस्, m. (fr. पुष्कल),
a species of grain; (अम्), n., N. of various Sāmans.

पौष्कलावति, इस्, m. (fr. पुष्कला-वती), N.
of a physician.

पौष्कल्य, अम्, n. full growth, maturity, com-
plete development.

पौष्टिक पौष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्टि),
relating to or promoting growth or welfare; nutri-
tious, nourishing, nutritive, fattening, invigorating;
preservative, protective; (अम्), n. a cloth worn dur-
ing the ceremony of tonsure.

पौष्टी, f. (probably fr. पुष्ट), N. of the wife
of Pūru.

पौष्ण पौष्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or
relating to Pūṣan, sacred to Pūṣan; relating to the
sun; (अम्), n. the last of the twenty-eight lunar
asterisms; the Nakṣatra Revatī.

पौष्प पौष्प, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्प), re-
lating or belonging to flowers, coming from flowers,
made of flowers, flowery, floral; (ई), f. the city of
Pāṭali-putra (= पुष्प-पुर).

पौष्पक, अम्, n. oxide of brass considered as
a collyrium, green vitriol.

पौष्पिञ्जि पौष्पिञ्जि, इस्, m. a patronymic;
N. of a teacher; (also read पौष्यिञ्जि.)

पौष्पिण्ड्य पौष्पिण्ड्य, अस्, m., N. of an
ancient teacher.

पौष्य पौष्य, अस्, -षी (?) , अम् (fr. पुष्य),
relating to the asterism Puṣya; (fr. पौष्य), re-
lating to or treating of king Pauṣya, an epithet of
the third Adhyāya of the Ādi-parva of the Mahā-
bhārata; (अस्), m., N. of a prince the son of Pūṣan
and king of Karavīra-pura.
